description: Stark describes surveillance and behavioural regulation extended into all the settings where the victim previously felt free - which is what distinguishes control from jealousy.
energy_note: No room left that is not observed.

aspect: Switching it off is the incident
description: The monitoring is unremarkable until it stops, at which point the stopping becomes the subject and requires explanation.
energy_note: Turning it off is the thing she has to justify.

description: 'You've been at your sister's a while x' She has been there fifty minutes. He is not accusing her of anything, and she now knows he is watching the dot.
energy_note: One kiss on the end, and she leaves early.
